propositions.text: Zhe Basmah is a student at Lycée of Dignity University.
Zhe Basmah's roll number is 789323889085.
The interviewer named Zhe has roll number 132305666219.
The interviewee's full name is Zhe Basmah.
The project involves making yarn by recycling plastic bottles for textiles and grocery use.
There exists a company called 'wool and Gang' producing yarn from plastic bottles as a competitor.
The experiment is named EXPERIMENT-1.
The project involves conducting an interview.
The team number is 10.
There are two dates mentioned: 28th September 2021 and 5th October 2021.
The interviewer asked about the interviewee’s profession.
The interviewer asked about what the interviewee experienced recently.
The interviewer asked about what annoyed the interviewee recently.
The interviewee observed that many plastic bottles were thrown at the beach side and everywhere in the city leading to environmental pollution.
The interviewee is annoyed by the usage and chemicals in plastic because they cause environmental pollution and many animals have died from eating plastic.
The interviewer asked what helps the interviewee save money.
The interviewer asked about the biggest challenge faced.
The interviewer asked if the interviewee thinks profits can be earned by providing low-cost products through the service.
The interviewer asked if there are companies or apps that have done this type of service before.
The interviewee stated that money can be saved by making yarn through recycling plastic bottles to use for textiles and grocery bags.
The biggest challenge is promoting awareness among people about using items made from recycled plastic to reduce plastic in nature sustainably.
The interviewee believes profits can be earned because such products are long lasting, tough, and conserve nature.
There is another company like Wool and Gang that tries to make yarn from plastic.
The interviewee’s wish is that all plastic should be recycled and used without damaging the environment because it is sustainable.
The conclusion thanks the interviewee for their time and states the discussion will help understand more about the interviewee.
The interviewee responds that it has been a pleasure.
